summary: Waton Financial Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing two agreements. First, its subsidiary Waton AI acquired a convertible promissory note for US$2,822,626, later converted into 7,500,000 preferred shares of PandaAI Quantum Holdings at US$0.3764/share. Second, Waton entered a finder's agreement with OCASIA to assist its wholly-owned SPAC, Love Health Limited, in identifying a business combination target. The finder receives a 1% success fee on pre-money valuation over $400M (negotiable below) plus a $1.2M upfront cash payment, with a twelve-month tail. Watch for SPAC merger announcements as the finder seeks targets.
